newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela making progress on labor reform - Petkoff.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela making progress on labor reform - Petkoff.

text.p: The tripartite commission of business, union and government representatives has made significant progress on the way to resolving social security and severance benefits reform, Planning Minister Teodoro Petkoff said Thursday.

The commission, on which Petkoff represents the government, "is working very intensively in a calm and favorable climate in a process I would describe as one of successive approximations," Petkoff told reporters in Congress.

Petkoff would not put a date on the three sides reaching a final agreement on the labor issues and hinted it would still take time, "because what we are discussing is a fundamental change in labor relations and this requires a lot of patience."
Petkoff said labor and business leaders had already agreed on many points such as how to reform the social security system and the need to replace wage bonuses with real salaries.
